aims.title: Teach Claude for everything
aims.body: Writing, research, studying, coding and everyday problem-solving: the whole range of work a student actually does, not one narrow use case.

aims.title: Deliver structured, hands-on Claude training
aims.body: Guided labs every other week, from using Claude well for everyday work to Claude Code and agentic tools.

aims.title: Run a structured build programme
aims.body: Biweekly hands-on sessions and two member projects, so everyone ships something real instead of collecting notes.

aims.title: Build a portfolio and a placement pipeline
aims.body: Club projects become resume lines, mock-interview material and, in time, internship and placement outcomes.

aims.title: Grow campus-wide visibility
aims.body: A flagship hackathon open to every student on campus, and a year-end demo day where members show what they built.
